title: Verify Flutter scaffold and development toolchain
description: On an equipped development machine, verify the Flutter/Dart versions and Android toolchain, run scaffold analysis/tests/build, and document actual outcomes before beginning timer implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Record actual Flutter, Dart, JDK, and Android SDK versions.
Run flutter pub get, flutter analyze, flutter test, and a debug Android build where tooling allows.
Record limitations and confirm the existing React/Capacitor app remains unchanged.
test_requirements: Use the commands and outcomes in FLUTTER_REWRITE.md, adjusting only for the actual environment.
Do not claim physical-device verification unless a named device is tested.
outstanding_issues: Flutter, Dart, Android SDK, and adb are unavailable in the current audited environment.
